name: White Shangri-La
original_name: ホワイト・シャングリラ
source:
You play as Yoyogi Eriko, aiming to join the members-only club "White Shangri-La". The membership test to become a full member is "getting covered in a lot of white liquid within 10 days". You need to efficiently move between several "bukkake spots" and get soaked in the white liquid as much as possible within 10 days. Depending on how things go, just getting splashed might not be enough for Eriko, or the men might want more than just splashing...

Since her usual appearance doesn't attract enough attention from men, Eriko boldly disguises herself when moving between spots. Changing her voice and playing completely different personalities is a piece of cake for Eriko, who aspires to be a voice actress. Sometimes she's a boyish, energetic girl, sometimes she's in cosplay as an anime character, and sometimes she's a beautiful older sister...

Enjoy Eriko's four different disguise variations.
You might even encounter someone who loves the real Eriko... maybe?

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100307030448/http://cats-box.jp/wshangrila]official site[/url]]
translation:
你扮演代代木绘里子，目标是加入会员制俱乐部“白色香格里拉”。成为正式会员的会员测试是“10天内浑身沾满大量白色液体”。你需要在10天内高效地在几个“颜射点”之间移动，并尽可能多地浸泡在白色液体中。根据事情的发展情况，仅仅被溅到对埃里科来说可能还不够，或者男人们可能想要的不仅仅是溅水……

由于她平时的外表并没有引起男人足够的关注，所以在不同地点之间移动时，Eriko大胆地伪装自己。改变声音并扮演完全不同的性格，对于立志成为声优的绘里子来说是小菜一碟。有时是男孩气十足的活力少女，有时是cosplay的动漫人物，有时又是美丽的姐姐……

享受Eriko的四种不同的伪装变化。
你甚至可能会遇到一个爱真正的Eriko的人……也许？

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100307030448/http://cats-box.jp/wshangrila]官方网站[/url]]
